items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: the first time I ever heard of Norman a fellow

ctx.x: Well, at that time -- the first time I ever heard of Norman a fellow -- $200.00 working in the band would be tops. And here come Norman Granz with his Jazz at the Philharmonic and those kind of places -- he was paying six and $700, which was unheard of.
Of course that drew every decent musician in the country trying to get with Norm Granz. But he -- he's worth it. He really treats them royally if he likes you.
Yeah, Duke used to -- when they were getting along --
